Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Chefs annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Chefs and Head Cooks ($80,330). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $80,330, Austin $62,400, Chicago $60,770. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Chefs?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Chefs and Head Cooks (6,840 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 6,840, Seattle 3,740, Austin 1,710. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Chefs most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Seattle has the highest published location quotient (1.39). Published LQs: Seattle 1.39, Chicago 1.18, Austin 1.03.

What is the hourly median for Chefs in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $30.00; Chicago $29.22; Seattle $38.62. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
